title: Grand Luxe | KEY.co
description_expanded: Grand Luxe is a breathtaking retreat in Miramar Beach, where refined elegance meets relaxed coastal living. Thoughtfully designed with warm wood accents, natural textures, and an inviting sea-inspired palette, this brand-new luxury home offers a seamless blend of comfort and sophistication. Spanning over 4,100 square feet, its spacious layout is perfect for large families and groups seeking a private sanctuary to gather, unwind, and make unforgettable memories. Whether lounging in the grand living room, sharing meals in the elegant dining area, or retreating to one of the beautifully appointed bedrooms, every space is crafted for both relaxation and connection. Outdoor living at Grand Luxe is just as spectacular, with expansive patios, a private pool, and a covered lounge area designed for both entertainment and tranquility. Inside, high-end finishes, modern amenities, and an impressive game room create an atmosphere of effortless luxury. Multiple balconies offer serene views, while the well-appointed kitchen and oversized dining space make hosting a delight. With its impeccable design, spacious accommodations, and premier location near Miramar Beach’s pristine shores, Grand Luxe is more than just a vacation home—it’s a coastal haven where every moment feels extraordinary.
